agent_type_tiers_comment: Maps an agent type to a tier, skipping prompt classification entirely: a role is known, a prompt is a guess. Shipped with this project's own router-* roles and Claude Code's built-in types. Add entries here for agents from any other tool you use — their names are theirs, not ours to assume.

codex.comment: Codex settings. chains give each tier its own model, not one model at three efforts: a small model thinking hard is rarely the same trade as a large one thinking briefly. List what your account offers with `jq -r '.models[].slug' ~/.codex/models_cache.json`. allowed_accounts is empty by default, which means cxr never refuses; populate it only if workspaces.enabled is true.

workspaces.comment: Optional. Only useful if you hold more than one subscription and care which one a directory bills. Labels are arbitrary; the router only compares them.

quota.comment: codex-quota reads Codex's own rate-limit records. Replace with any command printing JSON if your host exposes quota differently; empty disables the probe.

advisor.comment: delegate=false silences the nudge that asks an expensive session to hand bounded work to a subagent.
